summary: Iteration 48 — Voice AI Assistant inside Now Brief card verified end-to-end. Backend 8/8 pytest cases pass (POST /api/wingman/quick-chat admin+history+papa+noauth-optional; POST /api/dashboard/now-brief 200+401; POST /api/assistant/stt Whisper multipart; POST /api/assistant/tts/stream returns audio/mpeg via OpenAI fallback as expected). Frontend on mobile 390x844: NowBriefCard renders at top of dashboard for both kishan (Admin) and bsingh (Papa) with ✨ NOW BRIEF header, state chip, mute + refresh, Hold-to-Speak mic pill, keyboard toggle. Auto daily brief appears within ~4s with typewriter caret ▌. Refresh regenerates brief (chip → 'Reply'). Keyboard toggle opens TextInput with autofocus + send; typing 'Aaj kitne shipments hain?' returns a Hinglish reply that lists REAL consignment IDs (AURA-PEN-001, AURA-IT-002, AURA-IT-001, AURA-DEL-002, AURA-DEL-001) confirming the real-DB snapshot injection is working. History pill appears after send, tapping it re-narrates the corresponding response. Clear-history × present. Close-text-input × returns to Hold-to-Speak. Papa role shows the 'Papa Mode · Simple Hindi · Singh Exports only' hint under the input row and replies address the user as 'Papa ji 🙏'. No regressions observed on the rest of the dashboard (ledger, warehouse, vault snapshot, stat carousel, bullion widgets, assets on hand, reports carousels all render unchanged). Only pre-existing P2 RN-Web warnings observed (shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents/useNativeDriver deprecation, single 'Invalid style property of background' log, ElevenLabs 401 which auto-falls-back to OpenAI TTS as per spec).

react_native_issues.issue: RN-Web P2 warnings continue in this file: shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents props are deprecated; Animated useNativeDriver falls back to JS on web. Consistent with pre-existing codebase pattern flagged in iter42/47 — no new regression.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2239 /api/wingman/quick-chat uses Depends(optional_current_user) so it responds to unauthenticated callers too — role defaults to Admin. Acceptable because the endpoint is read-only chat with a snapshot-scoped data block, but worth documenting; consider requiring auth for consistency with /api/dashboard/now-brief which uses get_current_user.
server.py:2258 real_ctx assistant_context() is fetched on every call — for a chat endpoint hit frequently this may add latency. Consider a short (30-60s) TTL cache keyed by company_id.

server.py:2296 history recap is prepended to `prompt` AND session_id is passed to LlmChat — some LLM SDKs already persist history by session_id, so the client-side history plus server-side session can double-count context. Not a correctness issue observed in testing, but worth reviewing.

now-brief-card.tsx is 1041 lines — exceeds the 700-line file-size guideline. Consider splitting into sub-components (MicButton, WaveformStrip, HistoryPills, TextInputRow, StateChip) for maintainability.
wingman-api.ts good — thin, typed client, uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and bearer-token from secure store via existing helper.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Voice AI in Now Brief card is stable on web preview. Mic recording via getUserMedia is NOT verified in headless Playwright (browser blocks). To verify STT end-to-end use a real device or Expo Go, or curl the /api/assistant/stt endpoint with a real m4a/webm audio (silent wav is accepted). TTS uses OpenAI shimmer fallback because ElevenLabs 401 (invalid key) — expected per spec. Key testIDs: now-brief-card, now-brief-mute, now-brief-refresh, now-brief-mic, now-brief-keyboard-toggle, now-brief-text-input, now-brief-text-send, now-brief-close-text, now-brief-history-{i}, now-brief-history-clear, now-brief-retry, now-brief-stop-speaking. Login is at page root — testIDs signin-username / signin-password; primary CTA text 'LOG IN & OPEN DASHBOARD'. To switch users, evaluate localStorage.clear() + reload since there is no explicit logout testID on the sign-in-first screens.
